body.cap: Synergy AI received the CES 2024 Innovation Award for Mac'AI, its AI-powered cardiac disease prediction solution based on ECG data, recognizing its excellence.│Image by Synergy AI

body.x: Synergy AI (CEO Tae-young Shin) announced its participation in CES 2025, to be held from January 7th (Tuesday) to January 10th (Friday) in Las Vegas, USA, under the "K-Startup Pavilion."

Founded in 2018 by Professor Tae-young Shin from Ewha Womans University School of Medicine, Synergy AI is a health tech company aiming to revolutionize human health through the convergence of medicine and AI technology. The company provides cutting-edge solutions in cardiac disease prediction, medical imaging analysis, and more, delivering innovative value to the global medical industry.

Its flagship product, Mac’AI, is software that uses ECG data to predict the likelihood of arrhythmia within 14 days. Mac’AI enables medical professionals to understand patients' conditions better and devise optimal treatment plans. By improving efficiency in both research and clinical environments, Mac’AI will be offered as a non-covered service at medical institutions in Korea starting in 2025. Synergy AI expects this to benefit more patients and healthcare providers.

Synergy AI also developed HyperMedicus, an automated medical record solution that enhances medical practices. It analyzes real-time conversations between patients and doctors to automatically generate medical records, reducing administrative workloads and improving patient care efficiency.

The company’s portfolio includes Ignite, an AI solution that analyzes CT images to measure kidney volume. Ignite provides fast and accurate Total Kidney Volume (TKV) data for ADPKD patients, aiding prognosis and treatment decisions. Its ability to automatically measure the complex kidney shapes of ADPKD patients demonstrates Synergy AI’s advanced medical imaging technology.

Based in Seoul, Synergy AI is expanding its operations globally, including in the United States, Europe, Indonesia, and Nigeria. Its innovative technology has gained attention both domestically and internationally. Mac’AI was awarded the CES 2024 Innovation Award, and the CEO has established partnerships with major venture capital firms and hospitals in the U.S. through a global acceleration program.

body.cap: Synergy AI represented Korea at the Startup World Cup, advancing to the finals in San Francisco and showcasing its technology globally.│Image by Synergy AI

body.x: Mac’AI, Synergy AI's key product to showcase at CES 2025, stands out for its accuracy and efficiency. It uses AI algorithms trained on extensive ECG data to analyze the likelihood of arrhythmia quantitatively, minimizing errors caused by subjective judgment during traditional diagnostic processes. This allows medical professionals to make reliable data-driven diagnoses and treatment plans, delivering more effective healthcare services to patients.

Mac’AI’s user-friendly design integrates seamlessly with existing hospital medical devices and databases. When ECG data is uploaded, the system automatically analyzes it and generates reports quickly. These automated features reduce administrative burdens and allow medical staff to spend more time on patient care. Mac’AI also helps identify high-risk patients likely to develop arrhythmias, providing deeper insights into their conditions.

Mac’AI’s scalability and global adaptability are significant advantages. It has been designated as an "innovative medical technology under evaluation" in Korea and is already installed in 11 university hospitals, with installations underway in over 30 additional institutions. Its utility will be quickly validated with non-covered prescriptions, generating revenue immediately. Designed to comply with global standards, Mac’AI is also being prepared for U.S. FDA approval, making it applicable across diverse international medical environments.

Mac’AI is also an excellent tool for research and clinical trials. Researchers can use it to conduct in-depth analyses of data related to cardiac diseases, contributing to new medical insights and treatment methods. Through multi-center clinical trials and global collaborations, Mac’AI has the potential to create medical evidence that could redefine standards for patient care.

body.cap: CEO Tae-young Shin│Image by Synergy AI

body.x: A Synergy AI representative stated, “Mac’AI combines accuracy, efficiency, ease of use, scalability, and research support capabilities, making it a next-generation medical AI solution poised to transform cardiac disease management. Through this exhibition, we aim to showcase Mac’AI’s technology to medical professionals and investors worldwide, laying the groundwork for a leap in the global health tech market.”

The representative added, “With domestic revenue as a foundation, Synergy AI plans to secure funding from domestic and international investors to conduct clinical trials in the U.S. and obtain FDA approval. FDA clearance is a critical step for global expansion. After that, we aim to secure Medicare coverage and sell Mac’AI across the U.S. This strategy will strengthen our presence in the U.S. market and establish Synergy AI as a global leader in health tech.”
